Base Impact Damage: 100. After the teleportation, creates a huge shockwave that instantly deals damage to nearby enemies based on the caster's strength plus a base amount. Enemies also have their movement and attack speed slowed, and take additional damage over time based on the caster's strength.

Parasma.name: Parasma
Parasma.description: Warning: There is no antidote if picked up by the wrong end.

abilities.name: Witch Blade
abilities.description: The next attack poisons the target, slowing their movement speed and dealing damage over time, based on the wielder's intelligence. This attack cannot miss. Cooldown: 9. Intelligence as Damage per Second: 75%. Move Speed Slow: 25%. Duration: 4.

abilities.name: Magic Corruption
abilities.description: The wielder's attacks apply a magic resistance reducing debuff on enemy units. Duration: 4.

Pavise.name: Pavise
Pavise.description: Devised by a wizard who made one too many enemies.

abilities.name: Protect
abilities.description: Grants the target ally a physical damage barrier for a while. Cooldown: 16. Mana Cost: 60. Cast Range: 1000. Duration: 7.

Perseverance.name: Perseverance
Perseverance.description: A gem that grants heart to the bearer.

Phase Boots.name: Phase Boots
Phase Boots.description: Boots that allow the wearer to travel between the ether.

abilities.name: Phase
abilities.description: Increases the wielder's movement speed, and grants them phased movement for a while. Cooldown: 8. Mana Cost: 0. Move Speed Bonus: 10%. Duration: 3. Move Speed Bonus: 20%. Grants even more movement speed, and greatly improves the turn rate if the wielder is melee.

Phylactery.name: Phylactery
Phylactery.description: An amulet overflowing with powerful magics.

abilities.name: Empower Spell
abilities.description: The next unit targeted ability the wielder casts deals additional magical damage in a separate instance, and debuffs the target, slowing their movement speed. Cooldown: 9. Damage: 150. Move Speed Slow: 30%. Duration: 3.

Pipe of Insight.name: Pipe of Insight
Pipe of Insight.description: A powerful artifact of mysterious origin, it creates barriers against magical forces.

abilities.name: Barrier
abilities.description: Grants nearby allied units and buildings a magical damage barrier for a while. Cooldown: 60. Mana Cost: 150. Radius: 1200. Duration: 8. Stack Limit Duration: 59.

abilities.name: Insight Aura
abilities.description: Increases the health regeneration and magic resistance of nearby allies. Radius: 1200. Magic Resistance Bonus: 8%. Aura Linger Duration: 0.5.

Platemail.name: Platemail
Platemail.description: Thick metal plates that protect the entire upper body. Avoid dropping on feet.

Point Booster.name: Point Booster
Point Booster.description: A perfectly formed amethyst that nourishes body and mind when held.

Power Treads.name: Power Treads
Power Treads.description: A pair of tough-skinned boots that change to meet the demands of the wearer.

abilities.name: Switch Attribute
abilities.description: Meepo Clones cannot cast this ability. However, the Clones instantly update their switched attribute whenever the Prime switches the item's attributes. Cooldown: 0. Selected Attribute Bonus: 10.

Quelling Blade.name: Quelling Blade
Quelling Blade.description: The axe of a fallen gnome, it allows you to effectively maneuver the forest.

abilities.name: Chop Tree
abilities.description: Instantly destroys the targeted tree. Cooldown: 4. Mana Cost: 0. Cast Range: 350.

abilities.name: Quell
abilities.description: Grants the wielder bonus attack damage against non-hero units. Attack Damage Bonus: 8.

Radiance.name: Radiance
Radiance.description: A divine weapon that causes damage and a bright burning effect that lays waste to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Burn
abilities.description: When active, scorches nearby enemies, dealing magical damage over time. Cooldown: 0. Mana Cost: 0. Radius: 650. Damage per Second: 35. Burn applied by illusions deals less damage.

Reaver.name: Reaver
Reaver.description: A massive axe capable of tearing whole mountains down.

Refresher Orb.name: Refresher Orb
Refresher Orb.description: A powerful artifact created for wizards.

abilities.name: Reset Cooldowns
abilities.description: Resets the cooldowns of all abilities of the wielder. Cooldown: 180. Mana Cost: 325. On the first three uses, the item's cooldown increases.

Refresher Shard.name: Refresher Shard
Refresher Shard.description: Across an epoch of endless battle, the Immortal's will to triumph never faltered.

abilities.name: Reset Cooldowns
abilities.description: Resets the cooldowns of all abilities of the wielder. Cooldown: 180. Mana Cost: 200.

Revenant's Brooch.name: Revenant's Brooch
Revenant's Brooch.description: The cursed brooch of a fallen guardian who stalks forever between the veil of life and death.

abilities.name: Phantom Critical
abilities.description: The wielder's attacks have a chance to inflict critical magical damage. Proc Chance: 30%. Critical Damage: 80%.

Ring of Basilius.name: Ring of Basilius
Ring of Basilius.description: Ring given as a reward to the greatest mages.

abilities.name: Basilius Aura
abilities.description: Increases the mana regeneration of nearby allies. Radius: 1200. Mana Regeneration Bonus: 1. Aura Linger Duration: 0.5.

Ring of Health.name: Ring of Health
Ring of Health.description: A shiny ring found beneath a fat halfling’s corpse.

Ring of Protection.name: Ring of Protection
Ring of Protection.description: A glimmering ring that defends its bearer.

Ring of Regen.name: Ring of Regen
Ring of Regen.description: This ring is considered a good luck charm among the Gnomes.

Ring of Tarrasque.name: Ring of Tarrasque
Ring of Tarrasque.description: An ageless ring forged with an otherwise simple blood magic amplified by the presumed source of its key component.

Robe of the Magi.name: Robe of the Magi
Robe of the Magi.description: This robe corrupts the soul of the user, but provides wisdom in return.

Rod of Atos.name: Rod of Atos
Rod of Atos.description: Atos, the Lord of Blight, has his essence stored in this deceptively simple wand.

abilities.name: Cripple
abilities.description: Launches a projectile at the target enemy, rooting them in place and revealing them. Cooldown: 18. Mana Cost: 100. Cast Range: 1100. Duration: 2.

Roshan's Banner.name: Roshan's Banner
Roshan's Banner.description: Roshan's Banner is a Kill Reward item dropped by Roshan on his second death and onwards.

abilities.name: Place Banner
abilities.description: Creeps' attacks are not effective on Roshan's Banner. Cooldown: 1. Cast Range: 1200. Effect Radius: 600/900/1200. Invulnerability Duration: 120. Banner Duration: 120. Aura Linger Duration: 0.1.

Sacred Relic.name: Sacred Relic
Sacred Relic.description: An ancient weapon that often turns the tides of war.

Sage's Mask.name: Sage's Mask
Sage's Mask.description: A mask commonly used by mages and warlocks for various rituals.

Sange.name: Sange
Sange.description: Sange is an unusually accurate weapon, seeking weak points automatically.

Sange and Yasha.name: Sange and Yasha
Sange and Yasha.description: When attuned by the moonlight and used together, become a very powerful combination.

Satanic.name: Satanic
Satanic.description: Immense power at the cost of your soul.

abilities.name: Lifesteal
abilities.description: The wielder's attacks steal their target's life, healing the wielder for a portion of physical attack damage dealt.

abilities.name: Unholy Rage
abilities.description: Applies a basic dispel on the caster and greatly increases the lifesteal value for a short duration. Cooldown: 30. Mana Cost: 0. Duration: 6.

Scythe of Vyse.name: Scythe of Vyse
Scythe of Vyse.description: The most guarded relic among the cult of Vyse, it is the most coveted weapon among magi.

abilities.name: Hex
abilities.description: Applies a hex on the unit-targeted enemy upon cast and turns it into a harmless critter. Cooldown: 20. Mana Cost: 250. Cast Range: 800. Set Move Speed: 140. Hex Duration: 2.8. Current Health as Damage: 100%.

Sentry Ward.name: Sentry Ward
Sentry Ward.description: A form of plant originally grown in the garden of a fearful king.

abilities.name: Plant
abilities.description: Attacks against Sentry Wards cannot miss. Melee units have an increased attack range when attacking Sentry Wards. Cooldown: 1. Mana Cost: 0. Cast Range: 500. Vision Radius: 150. Vision Duration: 12. Ward Duration: 420. The player that placed the ward can always attack it with any of their units. However, all their attacks are treated as non-hero attacks, until the ward comes within the 50% deny range.

Shadow Amulet.name: Shadow Amulet
Shadow Amulet.description: A small talisman that clouds the senses of one's enemies when held perfectly still.

abilities.name: Fade
abilities.description: Turns the target invisible after a fade time. The invisibility is broken upon casting an ability or item, or upon attacking. Cooldown: 18. Mana Cost: 0. Cast Range: 600. Duration: 3.5. Move Speed Slow: 35%. Reduces the target's movement speed for the whole duration.

Shadow Blade.name: Shadow Blade
Shadow Blade.description: The blade of a fallen king, it allows you to move unseen and strike from the shadows.

abilities.name: Shadow Walk
abilities.description: The wielder becomes invisible and gains a movement speed bonus. Grants phase movement while invisible. Cooldown: 25. Mana Cost: 75. Move Speed Bonus: 20%. Duration: 17. Attack Damage Bonus: 175. The attack breaking invisibility deals physical attack damage bonus with the attack.

Shawl.name: Shawl
Shawl.description: Shawl is an item purchasable at the Base Shop, under Miscellaneous.

Shiva's Guard.name: Shiva's Guard
Shiva's Guard.description: Said to have belonged to a goddess, today it retains much of its former power.

abilities.name: Arctic Blast
abilities.description: Emits an expanding freezing wave that follows and covers an area around the caster, dealing damage and slowing movement speed of enemies as it reaches them. Cooldown: 27. Mana Cost: 75. Radius: 825. Damage: 260. Move Speed Slow: 40%. Slow Duration: 4.

abilities.name: Freezing Aura
abilities.description: Reduces the attack speed of nearby enemies. Radius: 1200. Attack Speed Slow: 45. Aura Linger Duration: 0.5.

Silver Edge.name: Silver Edge
Silver Edge.description: Once used to slay an unjust king, only to have the kingdom erupt into civil war in the aftermath.

abilities.name: Shadow Walk
abilities.description: The wielder becomes invisible and gains a movement speed bonus. Grants phase movement while invisible. Cooldown: 20. Mana Cost: 75. Move Speed Bonus: 20%. Duration: 17. Attack Damage Bonus: 300. Movement Speed Cap: 200.

Skull Basher.name: Skull Basher
Skull Basher.description: A feared weapon in the right hands, this maul's ability to shatter the defenses of its opponents should not be underestimated.

abilities.name: Bash
abilities.description: Grants the wielder's attacks a chance to stun the target and deal bonus physical damage. Cooldown: 2.3. Mana Cost: 0. Proc Chance: 25%. Damage: 100. Stun Duration: 1.2.

Slippers of Agility.name: Slippers of Agility
Slippers of Agility.description: Light boots made from spider skin that tingles your senses.

Smoke of Deceit.name: Smoke of Deceit
Smoke of Deceit.description: The charlatan wizard Myrddin's only true contribution to the arcane arts.

abilities.name: Disguise
abilities.description: While hero still disguised, any allied unit that comes within proximity of the caster also gets the buff applied to them. Cooldown: 1 second. Application Radius: 1200 units. Dispel Radius: 1025 units. Move Speed Bonus: 15%. Duration: 45 seconds. Proximity Radius: 300 units. Can be used directly from the backpack, and the 6-second penalty cooldown does not apply to Smoke of Deceit.

Solar Crest.name: Solar Crest
Solar Crest.description: A talisman forged to honor the daytime sky.

abilities.name: Shine
abilities.description: Grants the target ally a physical damage barrier for a while. Cooldown: 16. Mana Cost: 100. Cast Range: 1000. Duration: 7. Armor Bonus: 5. Move Speed Bonus: 15%. If not cast on self, also increases the target's armor, movement speed, and attack speed for the duration.

Soul Ring.name: Soul Ring
Soul Ring.description: A ring that feeds on the souls of those who wear it.

abilities.name: Sacrifice
abilities.description: Temporarily grants the wielder mana, at the cost of health. Cooldown: 25. Mana Cost: 0. Health Cost: 170. Mana Bonus: 170. Duration: 10.

Specialist's Array.name: Specialist's Array
Specialist's Array.description: An impressive kit of trigger enhancements born in an aging assassin's idle mind.

abilities.name: Splitshot
abilities.description: Ranged Only. Attacks have a chance to fire projectiles at 2 additional targets within a cone in front of the attacker. Does not trigger attack modifiers. Proc Chance: 30%. Search Range Buffer: 150. Bonus Attack Targets: 3. Additional Projectile Damage: 20 + 75% attack damage. Primary Attack Damage Bonus: 20.

Spirit Vessel.name: Spirit Vessel
Spirit Vessel.description: Forged by a god to entrap the soul of another.

abilities.name: Soul Release
abilities.description: When cast on an ally, consumes a charge to grant the target allied hero bonus health regeneration for a while. Number of Charges: ∞. Cooldown: 10. Mana Cost: 0. Cast Range: 750. Health Regen Bonus: 40. Duration: 8. When cast on an enemy, consumes a charge to deal damage over time to the target, based on their current health, as well as reduce the effectiveness of healing and health restoration the target receives.

Splintmail.name: Splintmail
Splintmail.description: Splintmail is an item purchasable at the Base Shop, under Equipment.

Staff of Wizardry.name: Staff of Wizardry
Staff of Wizardry.description: A staff of magical powers passed down from the eldest mages.

Swift Blink.name: Swift Blink
Swift Blink.description: A cunning blade able to anticipate and enable its bearer's movements.

abilities.name: Swift Blink
abilities.description: Instantly teleports the wielder towards the targeted point. Cooldown: 15 seconds. Mana Cost: 0. Cast Range: Global. Max Blink Distance: 1200 units. Move Speed Bonus: 40%. Agility Bonus: 35. After the teleportation, grants the caster phased movement, increased movement speed, and bonus agility for a while.

Talisman of Evasion.name: Talisman of Evasion
Talisman of Evasion.description: A necklace that allows you to anticipate enemy attacks.

Tango.name: Tango
Tango.description: Forage to survive on the battlefield.

abilities.name: Devour
abilities.description: Consumes the target tree to gain health regeneration for some time. The tree is destroyed in the process. Number of Charges: 3. Cooldown: 0. Mana Cost: 0. Cast Range: 165. Health Regen Bonus: 7. Duration: 16.

Tiara of Selemene.name: Tiara of Selemene
Tiara of Selemene.description: A symbol of favor bestowed upon the high priestess of Selemene.

abilities.name: Teleport
abilities.description: Cooldown: 80/40/40. Mana Cost: 75. Cast Range: Global. Teleport Check Radius: 1150. Teleport Check Timer: 25. Min Target Distance: 70.

abilities.name: Properties
abilities.description: All heroes start the game with an unsellable Town Portal Scroll. Initial Cooldown: 100.

abilities.name: Boots of Travel
abilities.description: Automatically and passively refunds all Town Portal Scrolls at full cost in the dedicated slot. Town Portal Scroll Cooldown: 40/40.

Tranquil Boots.name: Tranquil Boots
Tranquil Boots.description: While they increase the longevity of the wearer, this boot is not particularly reliable.

abilities.name: Break
abilities.description: Whenever the wielder attacks a hero or is attacked by a any unit, the boots' passive health regeneration bonus is lost, and the movement speed bonus is reduced for a while. Cooldown: 13 seconds. Move Speed Loss: 25%. Health Regen Loss: 14 points per second. Duration: 13 seconds.

Ultimate Orb.name: Ultimate Orb
Ultimate Orb.description: A mystical orb containing the essence of life.

Urn of Shadows.name: Urn of Shadows
Urn of Shadows.description: Contains the ashes of powerful demons.

abilities.name: Soul Release
abilities.description: When cast on an ally, consumes a charge to grant the target allied hero bonus health regeneration for a while. Number of Charges: ∞. Cooldown: 10. Mana Cost: 0. Cast Range: 750. Health Regen Bonus: 30. Duration: 8. When cast on an enemy, consumes a charge to deal damage over time to the target for a while.

Vanguard.name: Vanguard
Vanguard.description: A powerful shield that defends its wielder from even the most vicious of attacks.

abilities.name: Damage Block
abilities.description: Grants the wielder a chance to block a fixed portion of physical attack damage. Proc Chance: 60%. Blocked Damage: 50.

abilities.name: Spell Weakness
abilities.description: Weakens nearby enemies by applying a debuff that amplifies any spell damage they take. Cooldown: 16. Mana Cost: 50. Radius: 900. Spell Damage Amp: 10%. Duration: 16.

Vitality Booster.name: Vitality Booster
Vitality Booster.description: A ruby gemstone that has been passed down through generations of warrior kin.

Vladmir's Offering.name: Vladmir's Offering
Vladmir's Offering.description: An eerie mask that is haunted with the malice of a fallen vampire.

abilities.name: Vladmir's Aura
abilities.description: Increases the attack damage, mana regen, and armor of nearby allies, and grants them lifesteal. Radius: 1200. Attack Damage Bonus: 18%. Mana Regeneration Bonus: 1. Armor Bonus: 2. Aura Linger Duration: 0.5.

Void Stone.name: Void Stone
Void Stone.description: Jewelry that was once used to channel nether realm magic, this ring pulses with energy.

Voodoo Mask.name: Voodoo Mask
Voodoo Mask.description: A mask tuned to sip the arcane bindings that pass between caster and foe.

abilities.name: Magic Lifesteal
abilities.description: Restores the wielder's health for a portion of damage dealt by magical and physical spell damage. The lifesteal value is reduced by a factor of 0.2 against creeps.

Wind Lace.name: Wind Lace
Wind Lace.description: Hasten to battle on wind-touched heels.

Wind Waker.name: Wind Waker
Wind Waker.description: Proof enough to some that unseen forces manipulate the happenings of the material plane.

abilities.name: Cyclone
abilities.description: Sweeps the target up into a cyclone, applying a basic dispel, turning them invulnerable for a short while. Cooldown: 19. Mana Cost: 175. Cast Range: 550. Duration: 2.5. Damage: 50. Set Speed: 300. If the target is an enemy, they also take damage upon landing. Cannot lift up Roshan, instead, it instantly applies the damage.

Witch Blade.name: Witch Blade
Witch Blade.description: A spiteful blade inadvertently possessed by the soul of its incautious creator.

abilities.name: Witch Blade
abilities.description: The next attack poisons the target, slowing their movement speed and dealing damage over time, based on the wielder's intelligence. This attack cannot miss. Cooldown: 9. Intelligence as Damage per Second: 75%. Move Speed Slow: 25%. Duration: 4.

Wizard Hat.name: Wizard Hat
Wizard Hat.description: Wizard Hat is an item purchasable at the Base Shop, under Miscellaneous.

Wraith Band.name: Wraith Band
Wraith Band.description: A circlet with faint whispers echoing about it.

Yasha.name: Yasha
Yasha.description: Yasha is regarded as the swiftest weapon ever created.

Yasha and Kaya.name: Yasha and Kaya
Yasha and Kaya.description: Yasha and Kaya when paired together share a natural resonance.

Ash Legion Shield.name: Ash Legion Shield
Ash Legion Shield.description: Provides a physical damage barrier to nearby player units, slowing their movement speed.

effects.primary: Applies a physical damage barrier of 160 on all nearby player controlled units for 6 seconds, reducing incoming physical damage. Units within the radius have their move speed slowed by 20%.

Book of the Dead.name: Book of the Dead
Book of the Dead.description: Summons Necronomicon Warriors and Archers with strong attacks and abilities. Grants mana burn damage to warriors and slows enemies with archers.

effects.primary: Summons 2 Necronomicon Warriors and 2 Necronomicon Archers for 65 seconds. Warriors have a 0.75x attack damage multiplier and burn 50 mana per hit, dealing 50% of that as damage. Archers dispel enemies on cast and slow their movement speed by 100% (decaying to 20%) over 4 seconds.

Chipped Vest.name: Chipped Vest
Chipped Vest.description: Defends by retaliating with damage when attacked.

effects.primary: Returns 30 damage to heroes and 15 damage to creeps upon being attacked.

Conjurer's Catalyst.name: Conjurer's Catalyst
Conjurer's Catalyst.description: Deals spell damage that overheats enemies, causing them to damage nearby allies. Heroes take more damage.

effects.primary: Overheating an enemy deals additional damage to nearby allies; heroes take 104% more damage.

Crippling Crossbow.name: Crippling Crossbow
Crippling Crossbow.description: Hits an enemy for 25 damage, slows their movement speed by 50%, and reduces their health restoration effectiveness by 40% over time. The slow gradually decays. Cooldown: 12 seconds, Mana Cost: 50, Cast Range: 650.

effects.primary: Hits an enemy for 25 damage, slows their movement speed by 50%, and reduces their health restoration effectiveness by 40% over time.

notes: The slow gradually decays over the duration.

Dagger of Ristul.name: Dagger of Ristul
Dagger of Ristul.description: Allows you to temporarily gain significant attack damage at the cost of health.

effects.primary: Consume 100 health to gain 25 attack damage for 8 seconds. Cooldown: 30 seconds.

Defiant Shell.name: Defiant Shell
Defiant Shell.description: Grants a passive ability allowing the hero to instantly counter-attack a target within their attack range when attacked, dealing damage equal to 80% or 104% of their attack damage with a cooldown of 5 seconds.

effects.primary: Reciprocity: When attacked, the hero instantly counter-attacks a target within their attack range. Cooldown: 5. Deals 80% or 104% of attack damage.

Dezun Bloodrite.name: Dezun Bloodrite
Dezun Bloodrite.description: Grants an Ao E bonus to all spells of the wielder, including items. Mana cost is converted to health cost.

effects.primary: Ao E Bonus: 19.5%, Mana Cost as Health Cost: 35%.

Divine Regalia.name: Divine Regalia
Divine Regalia.description: Significantly boosts the wielder's outgoing damage.

effects.primary: Increases the wielder's outgoing damage by 20% and 26%.

Dormant Curio.name: Dormant Curio
Dormant Curio.description: Increases the potency of neutral items crafted while holding it.

effects.primary: Neutral items crafted while holding the Dormant Curio have their potency increased considerably.

Duelist Gloves.name: Duelist Gloves
Duelist Gloves.description: Grants attack speed to the wielder when enemy heroes are within a 1200-unit radius.

effects.primary: Attack Speed Bonus: 20% as long as there are enemy heroes within a 1200-unit radius.

Enchanter's Bauble.name: Enchanter's Bauble
Enchanter's Bauble.description: Enhances the bonuses of the item's Neutral Enchantment by stacking 15% on first craft and increasing by an additional 40% with each subsequent craft.

effects.primary: Increases the bonuses of the item's Neutral Enchantment by 15%. Every time this item is crafted again, the bonus is increased by 40%.

Essence Ring.name: Essence Ring
Essence Ring.description: Increases the caster's current and maximum health for a short time.

effects.primary: Increases the caster's current and maximum health by 312 for 10 seconds. Cooldown: 25. Mana Cost: 160.

Fallen Sky.name: Fallen Sky
Fallen Sky.description: Transforms into a meteor that strikes down at the target area after a delay, stunning enemies and dealing impact damage over time. Affects buildings as well, stunning and burning them with reduced impact damage.

effects.primary: Deals 150 impact damage immediately and continues to deal 60 damage per second for a while after landing.

notes: Affects buildings, stunning and burning them but taking less impact damage.

Flayer's Bota.name: Flayer's Bota
Flayer's Bota.description: Grants the wielder bonus attack damage and attack speed for a short while on cast. Cooldown resets when an enemy hero dies within range.

effects.primary: Grants 15% attack damage and 30% attack speed for 6 seconds. The cooldown is reset when an enemy hero dies within 1200 units.

Forager's Kit.name: Forager's Kit
Forager's Kit.description: Enables players to forage nearby trees for resources like flora, fungi, or gold once the cooldown is ready.

effects.primary: When the cooldown is ready, nearby trees that can be foraged will appear. By standing next to a tree for 1s, you can forage the tree and find flora, fungi, or a bag of gold containing gold.

Giant's Maul.name: Giant's Maul
Giant's Maul.description: Empowers the next attack with a critical hit and slows the target's movement, attack, and cast speed for 3 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds.

effects.primary: Critical Damage: 140%, Move Speed Slow: 10%, Attack Speed Slow: 15%, Cast Speed Slow: 20%, Duration: 3 seconds.

Gunpowder Gauntlet.name: Gunpowder Gauntlet
Gunpowder Gauntlet.description: Grants a passive effect that increases the damage of the next attack with an additional magical attack damage bonus and splash damage.

effects.primary: The next attack deals additional magical damage (156) against the primary target, with a 250 unit radius splash causing 50% of the base damage.

Harmonizer.name: Harmonizer
Harmonizer.description: Provides spell manacost reduction and amplification based on the cooldown state of spells.

effects.primary: Gain 5% spell manacost reduction for every spell off cooldown and 5% spell amplification for every spell on cooldown. Manacost Reduction per Spell Off Cooldown: 5%. Spell Amplification per Spell On Cooldown: 6. Manacost Reduction per Spell Off Cooldown: 6.5%. Spell Amplification per Spell On Cooldown: 7.8%.

Idol of Scree'Auk.name: Idol of Scree'Auk
Idol of Scree'Auk.description: Grants slow resistance, evasion, and phased movement with a cooldown of 30 seconds.

effects.primary: Grants slow resistance (50%), evasion, and phased movement for 6.5 to 8.45 seconds.

Jidi Pollen Bag.name: Jidi Pollen Bag
Jidi Pollen Bag.description: Reduces the effectiveness of health restoration on nearby enemies and deals damage over time based on their maximum health.

effects.primary: Spreads pollen on nearby enemies, reducing health restore by 50% and dealing 9% of their max health as damage over 9 seconds.

Kobold Cup.name: Kobold Cup
Kobold Cup.description: Grants nearby allies increased movement speed for a short duration when cast.

effects.primary: Grants 10% movement speed to nearby allies (1000 radius) for 6 seconds. Cooldown: 40 seconds. Mana Cost: 40.

Mana Draught.name: Mana Draught
Mana Draught.description: Restores mana over time and reduces cooldown in water.

effects.primary: Restores 70 mana plus 3% of maximum mana every second for 6 seconds. Cooldown is 60 seconds.

notes: Cooldown speed is increased by 30% while standing in water.

Metamorphic Mandible.name: Metamorphic Mandible
Metamorphic Mandible.description: Enter into an insect form for a short while, gaining magic resistance and movement speed.

effects.primary: Enter into an insect form for 6.5 seconds, gaining 50% magic resistance, 20% movement speed, and reducing enemy armor by 45%. Cooldown: 30 seconds.

Minotaur Horn.name: Minotaur Horn
Minotaur Horn.description: Grants magic resistance and immunity to pure and reflected damage, dispelling negative effects from enemy spells.

effects.primary: Grants 60% magic resistance and full immunity to pure and reflected damage. Dispels any negative effects from enemy spells for 2.6 seconds.

Occult Bracelet.name: Occult Bracelet
Occult Bracelet.description: Grants a stack of mana regeneration upon being attacked, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.

effects.primary: Each time the wearer is attacked, they gain a stack of 0.4 mana regen, up to 5 stacks. Stacks last for 5 seconds.

Partisan's Brand.name: Partisan's Brand
Partisan's Brand.description: Increases spell damage dealt to player-controlled units by 9%.

effects.primary: Increases spell damage dealt to player-controlled units by 9%. Spell Damage Amp: 9%.

Pollywog Charm.name: Pollywog Charm
Pollywog Charm.description: Increases the health regeneration of a target ally for 14 seconds with a 45-second cooldown.

effects.primary: Increases the health regeneration of a target ally by 8 HP/second for 14 seconds.

Poor Man's Shield.name: Poor Man's Shield
Poor Man's Shield.description: Grants the wielder a chance to block a fixed portion of physical attack damage.

effects.primary: Damage Block: Proc Chance 50%, Blocked Damage 30; Proc Chance 100%, Melee Blocked Damage 39, Ranged Blocked Damage 26.

Possessed Mask.name: Possessed Mask
Possessed Mask.description: Heals the wearer for 5 HP on each attack.

effects.primary: Heals the attacker for 5 HP on each attack.

notes: Lifesteal is not functional against wards, buildings, and allied units.
Self-Illusions do not benefit from lifesteal despite visible particles.

Prophet's Pendulum.name: Prophet's Pendulum
Prophet's Pendulum.description: Reduces incoming damage by 30% and delays the remaining damage over 5 seconds.

effects.primary: Reduces incoming damage by 30% and delays the remaining damage over 5 seconds.

notes: Linger effect reduces incoming damage by 30% and delays it for 5 seconds.

Psychic Headband.name: Psychic Headband
Psychic Headband.description: Provides an active psychic push ability with a cooldown of 15 seconds.

effects.primary: Psychic Push - Cooldown: 15. Mana Cost: 0. Cast Range: 600. Push Distance: 400. Push Duration: 0.3.

notes: Push Distance is mentioned twice, possibly an error in the original data.

Rattlecage.name: Rattlecage
Rattlecage.description: After taking cumulative damage, releases bone projectiles that deal damage and slow nearby enemies' movement and attack speed.

effects.primary: Deals 90 damage to up to 2 nearby enemies when the user cumulatively takes 220 damage over 7 seconds.

Riftshadow Prism.name: Riftshadow Prism
Riftshadow Prism.description: Creates an illusion at the cost of some health. The illusion spawns with full health and deals 50% of the user's damage while taking 200%. Lasts for 20 seconds with a cooldown of 27 seconds.

effects.primary: Creates an illusion with 8% × Current HP cost. The illusion has full health, deals 50% damage, and takes 200%. Lasts for 20 seconds.

Searing Signet.name: Searing Signet
Searing Signet.description: Instances of magic damage from spells over a threshold ignite enemies if they are within range, causing them to take damage over time.

effects.primary: Enemies within 2000 units take 80 damage over 6 seconds when hit by spells dealing over 60 magic damage. Creep damage is reduced by 50%.

Seeds of Serenity.name: Seeds of Serenity
Seeds of Serenity.description: Heals allied units within a 400 radius area with health regeneration for 8 seconds. The regen bonus is 8 plus 25% of the caster's health regeneration. Cooldown: 35 seconds.

effects.primary: Health Regeneration Aura - Heals allied units within a 400 radius for 8 seconds with a regen bonus of 8 + 25% of the caster's health regeneration. Cooldown: 35 seconds.

Serrated Shiv.name: Serrated Shiv
Serrated Shiv.description: Gut 'Em attacks have a chance to deal bonus physical damage based on the target's current health.

effects.primary: Attacks have a 20% chance to deal True Strike and additional physical damage equal to 8% of the target's current health, plus an extra 200 attack damage. Against Roshan, it deals an additional 260 attack damage.

Spellslinger.name: Spellslinger
Spellslinger.description: Recovers a percentage of mana cost from casting abilities over time.

effects.primary: 20% of the mana used to cast abilities is recovered over 10 seconds. Mana Cost Refunded: 20%. Duration: 10.

Spider Legs.name: Spider Legs
Spider Legs.description: Grants increased movement speed and turn rate, allowing for faster traversal and more agile pathing.

effects.primary: Grants a 20% move speed bonus, 50% turn rate bonus, and free pathing. Cooldown: 20s. Duration: 14s.
Cooldown: 6.

Stygian Desolator.name: Stygian Desolator
Stygian Desolator.description: Applies an armor reducing debuff to enemy units with increasing effectiveness over time.

effects.primary: Reduces enemy armor by 13 for the first hit, increasing to 16.9 after subsequent hits.

Tumbler's Toy.name: Tumbler's Toy
Tumbler's Toy.description: Propels the caster a short distance forward upon activation.

effects.primary: Propels the caster a short distance forward. Cooldown: 15 seconds. Mana Cost: 0. Leap Distance: 390 units.

Unrelenting Eye.name: Unrelenting Eye
Unrelenting Eye.description: Increases slow resistance, which decreases based on the number of enemy heroes in attack range, up to a maximum of 65%.

effects.primary: Relentless: Increases slow resistance by 50%, decreasing by 10% for each enemy hero within attack range, capping at 65%.

Weighted Dice.name: Weighted Dice
Weighted Dice.description: Increases the wielder's base attack damage and gold bounty by selecting the highest value from multiple calculations.

effects.primary: Increases base attack damage and gold bounty by selecting the highest value from two calculations, with a maximum bonus of 6 to base damage.

Witchbane.name: Witchbane
Witchbane.description: Dispel all enemies and allies in a 300 unit radius. Your attacks deal bonus damage equal to 4% of your target's Max Mana.

effects.primary: Dispels all enemies and allies in a 300 unit radius with a cooldown of 40 seconds and a mana cost of 150. Your attacks deal bonus damage equal to 4% of your target's Max Mana.
